reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml defines ValueSet.expansion.parameter 0..*, name 1..1, and value[x] with string, boolean, integer, decimal, uri, code, and dateTime; source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml explains that parameters record what controlled expansion and what should be included; the example expansion includes a parameter name/value pair.
